entities.summary: Paulo Menotti Del Picchia was a Brazilian poet, journalist, and painter who was born and died in São Paulo. He is associated with the Generation of 1922, the first generation of Brazilian modernism artists. Menotti Del Picchia was a legal figures from São Paulo (1892-03-20, São Paulo–1988-08-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
